# IHMC Public Cmaps (3)

> > A collaborative concept mapping platform for knowledge visualization, resource sharing, and educational management across multiple languages and communities.

IHMC Public Cmaps is a public repository hosted by the Institute for Human and Machine Cognition that enables collaborative concept mapping and knowledge management. The platform serves educational institutions, particularly in Panama, and provides tools for creating, sharing, and organizing visual knowledge representations.

## Key Topics

- Concept Mapping
- Knowledge Management
- Collaborative Learning
- Knowledge Visualization
- Resource Repository
- Public Repository
- IHMC Cmaps
- Educational Materials
- Panama Education

## Core Platform

- [IHMC Public Cmaps (3) - Home](https://cmapspublic3.ihmc.us): Main entry point to IHMC's public repository for collaborative concept mapping and knowledge management

## User Resources & Collaboration

- [Users - Create Your Own Folder](https://cmapspublic3.ihmc.us/rid=1160514559572_1737856583_34544/Users%20(create%20your%20own%20folder...)): User folder directory for creating personal concept maps and collaborative spaces in IHMC Cmaps

## Optional & Archives

- [Moved Cmaps and Resources - Archive](https://cmapspublic3.ihmc.us/rid=20KHT2ZDF-BW94TF-50/Moved%20Cmaps%20and%20resources%20(previously%20here)%20-%20Se%20movio%20recursos%20y%20Cmaps%20previamente%20en%20la%20raiz%20a%20esta%20carpeta): Archive of moved educational resources from CFEI David in Panama, including bilingual Spanish-English content
